WITH cd_filter AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'M'
      AND cd_marital_status = 'W'
      AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
),
dd_filter AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1999
),
st_filter AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT s_store_sk, s_state
    FROM store
    WHERE s_state IN ('TN','TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN')
),
sales_grp AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT i.i_item_id,
           stf.s_state,
           COUNT(ss.ss_quantity) AS qty_count,
           SUM(ss.ss_quantity)::numeric AS qty_sum,
           COUNT(ss.ss_list_price) AS list_price_count,
           SUM(ss.ss_list_price)::numeric AS list_price_sum,
           COUNT(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS coupon_amt_count,
           SUM(ss.ss_coupon_amt)::numeric AS coupon_amt_sum,
           COUNT(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sales_price_count,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price)::numeric AS sales_price_sum
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN cd_filter cdf ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cdf.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN dd_filter ddf ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = ddf.d_date_sk
    JOIN st_filter stf ON ss.ss_store_sk = stf.s_store_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, stf.s_state
)
SELECT i_item_id,
       s_state,
       GROUPING(s_state) AS g_state,
       SUM(qty_sum) / NULLIF(SUM(qty_count), 0) AS agg1,
       SUM(list_price_sum) / NULLIF(SUM(list_price_count), 0) AS agg2,
       SUM(coupon_amt_sum) / NULLIF(SUM(coupon_amt_count), 0) AS agg3,
       SUM(sales_price_sum) / NULLIF(SUM(sales_price_count), 0) AS agg4
FROM sales_grp
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_item_id, s_state)
ORDER BY i_item_id, s_state
LIMIT 100
